name: Berge (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Berge (a red pale and chequy bar on yellow).
history: The arms, designed by Hans Heinrich Reclam, were granted by the Landkreis Osnabrück on 16 May 1978; the flag is divided twice into yellow, red and white with the arms.

features.role: Berge arms — pale and chequy bar on yellow
